view.description: What holding fn shows. "spotlight" comes later.

layout.description: How the board sits on screen. Only "framed" for now.

theme.description: "dark-glass", "light-glass", "dracula", or a file in themes/ without ".json".

trigger.description: What opens the glance: a modifier key on its own (fn by default), or a shortcut. Set "key" or "shortcut", not both.

key.description: A modifier key, held or tapped on its own. Pressed with another key or modifier, it doesn't open the glance.

shortcut.description: A shortcut, like "⌃⌥Space" or "ctrl+option+space". Needs ⌃, ⌥ or ⌘, except for F1–F20. Keys are named by their place on a US keyboard.

mode.description: hold: shows while held. toggle: a tap or press shows, the next one or Esc hides. doubleTap: two taps of the key show, two more or Esc hide; keys only. Default: hold for a key, toggle for a shortcut.

holdMs.description: How long to hold before the glance shows. Only with "mode": "hold".

doubleTapMs.description: How soon the second tap must follow the first. Only with "mode": "doubleTap".

launchAtLogin.description: Start Tjuvkik when you log in.

menuBar.description: Panels in panels shown in the menu bar, in order. Each panel decides what it shows there; by default its first summary count.

pause.description: When panels stop running in the background. The glance always runs them.

whenLocked.description: While the screen is locked or the displays sleep.

onLowPower.description: While Low Power Mode is on.

notifications.description: Notifications from panels. A panel sends them with notify in its output, or its notify setting's on.

quietHours.description: Nothing is delivered between these times, local time.

whileOpen.description: Deliver while the glance is showing.

panels.description: Panels fill a 4×3 grid in order.

size.description: Size here; overrides the panel's own. s 1×1, m 2×1, l 2×2, xl 2×3

background.description: How often an interval panel runs while the glance is closed. true: every `every`. false: only while you glance. At least 5s. Overrides the panel's own.

show.description: false: the panel runs, for the menu bar, but has no spot on the grid.

minInterval.description: At most one notification this often. The rest are grouped.

on.description: failed: while the panel shows an error. warning, error: rows with that tone.
